user.title: Alvuna
user.description: Adds the Alvuna card for wall tablets and the Alvuna app for TVs.

pair.title: Pair a TV
pair.description: A TV is asking to show Alvuna. Pair it only if its screen shows the code **{code}**. It gets its own Home Assistant user: not an administrator, local network only.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. Living room TV.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing request expired. Open Alvuna on the TV again for a new code.

init.title: Alvuna
init.description: Alvuna builds the tablet and TV screens from your areas, floors and entities. Hide what should not show and pick a few things here; the rest follows Home Assistant.

data_description.source: Automatic follows your areas. From a dashboard uses the Alvuna card's own settings written on that dashboard.
data_description.dashboard: Its URL path, e.g. dashboard-home. Only for the dashboard layout.
data_description.hidden_areas: Areas that get no room tile.
data_description.weather: Leave empty to use the first weather entity.
data_description.tv_screensaver_minutes: Minutes without a key press. 0 turns it off.
data_description.tv_idle_minutes: Minutes without a key press. 0 keeps it open.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a message on paired TVs running Alvuna.

device_id.name: TVs
device_id.description: Leave empty for every paired TV.

show_camera.name: Show a camera
show_camera.description: Opens a camera full screen on paired TVs running Alvuna.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long before it closes by itself.

device_id.name: TVs
device_id.description: Leave empty for every paired TV.

not_a_tv.message: Device {device_id} is not a TV paired with Alvuna.
